_comment: Verification harness for fluid PR 6139 (owner reference GVK recovery). Consumed by scripts/re-verify.sh. Production code is NOT modified by this harness.

mutation._note: NOT RUNNABLE by re-verify.sh on purpose. H2b is provable only by inspecting the function signature / mutating production code, so it must never be auto-reported as FIXED just because a spec passed. Verify by hand: see README section 'H2b (mutation-only)'.

findings.title: Fully-empty TypeMeta must be recovered from the scheme (regression guard for the bug this PR fixes)
findings.observedOnPrHead: PASS - Kind/APIVersion correct for all 7 fluid kinds

findings.title: Partially populated TypeMeta skips recovery because gvk.Empty() requires all three of Group/Version/Kind to be empty
findings.observedOnPrHead: FAIL - Kind-only TypeMeta yields APIVersion:"" (not "/"); APIVersion-only yields Kind:""
findings.note: Confirmed real and still present at PR head. Goes green under the proposed fix (predicate widened to gvk.Kind=="" || gvk.Version=="").

findings.title: Canary pinning the actual malformed output for partial TypeMeta at PR head
findings.note: Flips to FAIL under the proposed fix (verified). When it flips, invert or delete it.

findings.title: Upstream apimachinery predicate semantics that cause H1 (auditable mechanism)
findings.observedOnPrHead: PASS - passes on both refs; documents that GVK{Kind:"X"}.Empty()==false and GroupVersion{}.String()==""

findings.title: GVKForObject error is swallowed: an unregistered type degrades with zero diagnostics
findings.observedOnPrHead: FAIL - 0 log records captured while returning Kind:"" APIVersion:"" Enabled:true
findings.note: Goes green when the fix logs the error instead of discarding it (verified: 1 record captured).

findings.title: Canary pinning the unusable ref returned for an unregistered type at PR head
findings.observedOnPrHead: PASS - Kind:"" APIVersion:"" (merge base emitted "/" instead, so this canary FAILS on the merge base)
findings.note: Stays PASS under a log-only fix, which is correct: logging does not make the returned reference usable.

findings.title: BlockOwnerDeletion:false alongside Controller:true - PRE-EXISTING, not a regression of this PR
findings.observedOnMergeBase: PASS - identical, confirming it is pre-existing context and not introduced here

findings.title: The function cannot signal failure at all: signature is func(client.Object) *common.OwnerReference with no error return
findings.observedOnPrHead: Confirmed by inspection: no error return, no bool, no event; callers unconditionally embed the result into Helm values.
findings.note: Deliberately on the non-runnable 'mutation' layer so re-verify.sh reports HARNESS-UPDATE/SKIPPED rather than falsely reporting FIXED.

liveNote: L3 NOT RUN. The available kubeconfig targets a shared production ACK cluster and the brief forbids mutating it. To close the loop on a disposable cluster: apply a Dataset+DataLoad, then `kubectl get <child> -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences}'` on the rendered Helm child resources and confirm apiVersion/kind are populated; a malformed ownerReference is rejected by the API server with 'ownerReferences.apiVersion: Invalid value: "": version must not be empty'.
